sloka: राक्षसाः परिरक्षेथास् तेभ्यस् त्वम् नित्यम् उद्यतः ।निम्नेषु वन दुर्गेषु वनेषु च वन ओकसः ॥६-४-१२॥।।
transliteration: rākṣasāḥ parirakṣethās tebhyas tvam nityam udyataḥ ।nimneṣu vana durgeṣu vaneṣu ca vana okasaḥ ॥6-4-12॥।।

translations.english: "O Vanaras You should even look for (the rakshasas) in the low lying lands, in inaccessible water sources, in forests and also beyond sight leaping up to the sky".
